arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: settle after the hard start to about critical power (boat ~122 W, shaft ~189 W, to be checked by heart rate: HR should level off at CP), spend reserve evenly, keep ~30-40 % reserve for the last 1000-1500 m, then finish sprint around 600-800 m to go. Watch for incidents (weed on rudder = speed drop at same pod power; pod drift = pod power vs boat power/HR disagree; radio course change). Use pieces/measure only if they pay.
Good start. Settle now into your race rhythm.

arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. CP revised (belief 203 W shaft, 195-212; test said 189) from flat HR at ~206 W. Hold ~205-208 W shaft (sustainable_shaft_power_w) through leg 7, watch HR slope (hr_climbing watch) and pod reserve across CP range. From ~1500 m to go build a little if reserve >30 %; finish sprint (ask finish) at ~500-600 m to go. Incidents: weed suspected 500-567 s, back-stroke at 567 s, speed restored on leg 3. Re-check speed vs pod power (watch drag_resid); clear_rudder again if a step loss appears. Radio messages: correct distance with set_race_distance.
